hooks.name: Period-accuracy review for in-world text
hooks.description: When story files, seeds or man pages change, asks the agent to review them against the 4.3BSD period-accuracy and story rules.

action.prompt: A file with in-world content was just saved. Before continuing, review the change against .kiro/steering/period-accuracy.md and .kiro/steering/story.md: (1) no anachronisms in Nell's world (no web, cloud, emoji, sudo, less, /home), unless the text belongs to Jack-o'-Daemon; (2) command output and error formats match 4.3BSD as documented; (3) lines are 80 columns or fewer; (4) tone is spooky-cute and safe for all ages. Fix any problems you find and say briefly what you changed.
